A little clarity
goes a long way.

What should I include in my request?

Describe the issue or project, the room involved, and what you would like to change. You do not need to know the technical name.

Can I ask about more than one job?

Yes. Include the different tasks in one request so they can be considered together.

Does this example accept real electrical jobs?

No. Current Electric is a fictional website concept. The request form demonstrates an inquiry flow only.

Designed around the way you live

Start with the symptoms.
